blocks.title: A Good Man Obtains Favor from the Lord

texts.NIV84: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.
texts.KJV: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge,
But he who hates correction is stupid.
texts.DRB: He that loveth correction, loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is foolish.

texts.NIV84: A good man obtains favor from the LORD, but the LORD condemns a crafty man.
texts.KJV: A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
texts.NKJV:
A good man obtains favor from the Lord,
But a man of wicked intentions He will condemn.
texts.DRB: He that is good, shall draw grace from the Lord : but he that trusteth in his own devices doth wickedly.

texts.NIV84: A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.
texts.KJV: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
texts.NKJV:
A man is not established by wickedness,
But the root of the righteous cannot be moved.
texts.DRB: Men shall not be strengthened by wickedness: and the root of the just shall not be moved.

texts.NIV84: A wife of noble character is her husband's crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.
texts.KJV: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
texts.NKJV:
An excellent wife is the crown of her husband,
But she who causes shame is like rottenness in his bones.
texts.DRB: A diligent woman is a crown to her husband: and she that doth things worthy of confusion, is a rottenness in his bones.

blocks.title: A Man Commended According to His Wisdom

texts.NIV84: The plans of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.
texts.KJV: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
texts.NKJV:
The thoughts of the righteous are right,
But the counsels of the wicked are deceitful.
texts.DRB: The thoughts of the just are judgments: and the counsels of the wicked are deceitful.

texts.NIV84: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
texts.KJV: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
texts.NKJV:
The words of the wicked are, “Lie in wait for blood,”
But the mouth of the upright will deliver them.
texts.DRB: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood: the mouth of the just shall deliver them.

texts.NIV84: Wicked men are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous stands firm.
texts.KJV: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
texts.NKJV:
The wicked are overthrown and are no more,
But the house of the righteous will stand.
texts.DRB: Turn the wicked, and they shall not be: but the house of the just shall stand firm.

texts.NIV84: A man is praised according to his wisdom, but men with warped minds are despised.
texts.KJV: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
texts.NKJV:
A man will be commended according to his wisdom,
But he who is of a perverse heart will be despised.
texts.DRB: A man shall be known by his learning: but he that is vain and foolish, shall be exposed to contempt.

blocks.title: With Good by the Fruit of His Mouth

texts.NIV84: Better to be a nobody and yet have a servant than pretend to be somebody and have no food.
texts.KJV: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
texts.NKJV:
Better is the one who is slighted but has a servant,
Than he who honors himself but lacks bread.
texts.DRB: Better is the poor man that provideth for himself, than he that is glorious and wanteth bread.

texts.NIV84: A righteous man cares for the needs of his animal, but the kindest acts of the wicked are cruel.
texts.KJV: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
texts.NKJV:
A righteous man regards the life of his animal,
But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
texts.DRB: The just regardeth the lives of his beasts: but the bowels of the wicked are cruel.

texts.NIV84: He who works his land will have abundant food, but he who chases fantasies lacks judgment.
texts.KJV: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
texts.NKJV:
He who tills his land will be satisfied with bread,
But he who follows frivolity is devoid of understanding.
texts.DRB: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that pursueth idleness is very foolish. He that is delighted in passing his time over wine, leaveth a reproach in his strong holds.

texts.NIV84: The wicked desire the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
texts.KJV: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
texts.NKJV:
The wicked covet the catch of evil men,
But the root of the righteous yields fruit.
texts.DRB: The desire of the wicked is the fortification of evil men: but the root of the just shall prosper.

texts.NIV84: An evil man is trapped by his sinful talk, but a righteous man escapes trouble.
texts.KJV: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
texts.NKJV:
The wicked is ensnared by the transgression of his lips,
But the righteous will come through trouble.
texts.DRB: For the sins of the lips ruin draweth nigh to the evil mall: but the just shall escape out of distress.

texts.NIV84: From the fruit of his lips a man is filled with good things as surely as the work of his hands rewards him.
texts.KJV: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
texts.NKJV:
A man will be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth,
And the recompense of a man’s hands will be rendered to him.
texts.DRB: By the fruit of his own mouth shall a man be filled with good things, and according to the works of his hands it shall be repaid him.

blocks.title: The Tongue of the Wise Promotes Health

texts.NIV84: The way of a fool seems right to him, but a wise man listens to advice.
texts.KJV: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
texts.NKJV:
The way of a fool is right in his own eyes,
But he who heeds counsel is wise.
texts.DRB: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that is wise hearkeneth unto counsels.

texts.NIV84: A fool shows his annoyance at once, but a prudent man overlooks an insult.
texts.KJV: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
texts.NKJV:
A fool’s wrath is known at once,
But a prudent man covers shame.
texts.DRB: A fool immediately sheweth his anger: but he that dissembleth injuries is wise.

texts.NIV84: A truthful witness gives honest testimony, but a false witness tells lies.
texts.KJV: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
texts.NKJV:
He who speaks truth declares righteousness,
But a false witness, deceit.
texts.DRB: He that speaketh that which he knoweth, sheweth forth justice: but he that lieth, is a deceitful witness.

texts.NIV84: Reckless words pierce like a sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
texts.KJV: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
texts.NKJV:
There is one who speaks like the piercings of a sword,
But the tongue of the wise promotes health.
texts.DRB: There is that promiseth, and is pricked as it were with a sword of conscience: but the tongue of the wise is health.

texts.NIV84: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
texts.KJV: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
texts.NKJV:
The truthful lip shall be established forever,
But a lying tongue is but for a moment.
texts.DRB: The lip of truth shall be steadfast for ever: but he that is a hasty witness, frameth a lying tongue.

texts.NIV84: There is deceit in the hearts of those who plot evil, but joy for those who promote peace.
texts.KJV: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
texts.NKJV:
Deceit is in the heart of those who devise evil,
But counselors of peace have joy.
texts.DRB: Deceit is in the heart of them that think evil things: but joy followeth them that take counsels of peace.

texts.NIV84: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.
texts.KJV: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
texts.NKJV:
No grave trouble will overtake the righteous,
But the wicked shall be filled with evil.
texts.DRB: Whatsoever shall befall the just man. it shall not make him sad: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

texts.NIV84: The LORD detests lying lips, but he delights in men who are truthful.
texts.KJV: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.
texts.NKJV:
Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord,
But those who deal truthfully are His delight.
texts.DRB: Lying lips are an abomination to the Lord: but they that deal faithfully please him.

texts.NIV84: A prudent man keeps his knowledge to himself, but the heart of fools blurts out folly.
texts.KJV: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
texts.NKJV:
A prudent man conceals knowledge,
But the heart of fools proclaims foolishness.
texts.DRB: A cautious man concealeth knowledge: and the heart of fools publisheth folly.

texts.NIV84: Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
texts.KJV: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
texts.NKJV:
The hand of the diligent will rule,
But the lazy man will be put to forced labor.
texts.DRB: The hand of the valiant shall bear rule: but that which is slothful, shall be under tribute.

texts.NIV84: An anxious heart weighs a man down, but a kind word cheers him up.
texts.KJV: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
texts.NKJV:
Anxiety in the heart of man causes depression,
But a good word makes it glad.
texts.DRB: Grief in the heart of a man shall bring him low, but with a good word he shall be made glad.

texts.NIV84: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
texts.KJV: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
texts.NKJV:
The righteous should choose his friends carefully,
For the way of the wicked leads them astray.
texts.DRB: He that neglecteth a loss for the sake of a friend, is just: but the way of the wicked shall deceive them.

texts.NIV84: The lazy man does not roast his game, but the diligent man prizes his possessions.
texts.KJV: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
texts.NKJV:
The lazy man does not roast what he took in hunting,
But diligence is man’s precious possession.
texts.DRB: The deceitful man shall not find gain: but the substance of a just man shall be precious gold.

texts.NIV84: In the way of righteousness there is life; along that path is immortality.
texts.KJV: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
texts.NKJV:
In the way of righteousness is life,
And in its pathway there is no death.
texts.DRB: In the path of justice is life: but the by-way leadeth to death.
